```{r load data, include=FALSE}

bw <- CreateSeuratObject(Read10X(data.dir="Data/Protocol_comparison/Brownjohn_filtered_bc_matrix"), project = "Brownjohn")
mq <- CreateSeuratObject(Read10X(data.dir="Data/Protocol_comparison/McQuade_filtered_bc_matrix"), project = "McQuade")

# add mitochondria percentage to the metadata
bw[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(bw, pattern = "^MT[-\\.]")
mq[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(mq, pattern = "^MT[-\\.]")

```

```{r check mitochondria percentage pre-filtering}

VlnPlot(bw, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.1) | VlnPlot(mq, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.1)

```

```{r check QC pre-filtering, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}

# check QC
VlnPlot(bw, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.1) | VlnPlot(mq, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.1)

# add an additional colun with log10 genes per UMI
bw$log10GenesPerUMI <- log10(bw$nFeature_RNA) / log10(bw$nCount_RNA)
mq$log10GenesPerUMI <- log10(mq$nFeature_RNA) / log10(mq$nCount_RNA)

merged_pre_filt <- merge(bw, y=mq) 

# number of cells before QC
n.cells <- merged_pre_filt@meta.data %>% 
  	ggplot(aes(x=orig.ident, fill=orig.ident)) + 
  	geom_bar(fill=c("#005F73", "#C94203")) +
  	theme_classic() +
  	theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) +
  	theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold")) +
  	ggtitle("Number of Cells before QC")

# number of transcripts per cells before QC
n.umi <- merged_pre_filt@meta.data %>% 
  	ggplot(aes(color=orig.ident, x=nCount_RNA, fill= orig.ident)) + 
  	geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + 
  	scale_x_log10() + 
  	theme_classic() +
  	ylab("Cell density")+
  	geom_vline(xintercept = 1000, linetype="dashed")+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold")) +
    ggtitle("UMI Counts per Cell before QC")+
    scale_color_manual(values=c("#005F73", "#C94203"))

# number of genes per cell before QC
n.gene <- merged_pre_filt@meta.data %>% 
  	ggplot(aes(color=orig.ident, x=nFeature_RNA, fill= orig.ident)) + 
  	geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + 
  	theme_classic() +
  	scale_x_log10() + 
  	geom_vline(xintercept = 500, linetype="dashed")+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold"))+
    ggtitle("Gene Counts per Cell before QC")+
    scale_color_manual(values=c("#005F73", "#C94203"))

n.cells | n.umi & NoLegend() | n.gene


gene_umi_pmt <- merged_pre_filt@meta.data %>% 
  	ggplot(aes(x=nCount_RNA, y=nFeature_RNA, color=percent.mt)) + 
  	geom_point() + 
	  scale_colour_gradient(low = "gray90", high = "black") +
  	stat_smooth(method=lm) +
  	scale_x_log10() + 
  	scale_y_log10() + 
  	theme_classic() +
  	geom_vline(xintercept = 1000, linetype="dashed") +
  	geom_hline(yintercept = 600, linetype="dashed") +
  	facet_wrap(~orig.ident)
gene_umi_pmt


complexity <- merged_pre_filt@meta.data %>%
  	ggplot(aes(x=log10GenesPerUMI, color = orig.ident, fill=orig.ident)) +
  	geom_density(alpha = 0.2) +
  	theme_classic() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.8, linetype="dashed")+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold")) +
    ggtitle("Complexity before QC")+
    scale_color_manual(values=c("#005F73", "#C94203"))
complexity
```

```{r preprocess}

# normalize, find variable genes, scale data and run UMAP
bw <- NormalizeData(bw) %>% 
        FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000) %>% 
        ScaleData(vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA","percent.mt")) %>% 
        RunPCA(npcs = 50) 
mq <- NormalizeData(mq) %>% 
        FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000) %>% 
        ScaleData(vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA","percent.mt")) %>% 
        RunPCA(npcs = 50) 

# Add a line with sample identity - in a new column called "protocol"
bw@meta.data$protocol <- c("Brownjohn")
mq@meta.data$protocol <- c("McQuade")

```

```{r merge}

merged <- merge(bw, y = mq, project ="Protocol comparison",
                              add.cell.ids = c("Brownjohn", "McQuade"))

```


```{r regress out cell cycle from merged}

# Read in the expression matrix The first row is a header row, the first column is rownames
exp.mat <- read.table(file = "Data/cell_cycle_vignette_files/nestorawa_forcellcycle_expressionMatrix.txt", header = TRUE, 
    as.is = TRUE, row.names = 1)

# A list of cell cycle markers, from Tirosh et al, 2015, is loaded with Seurat.  We can
# segregate this list into markers of G2/M phase and markers of S phase
s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes


merged <- FindVariableFeatures(merged, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 3000)
VariableFeatures(merged) <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(merged), unique(c(s.genes, g2m.genes)))

merged <- ScaleData(merged, vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA","percent.mt","S.Score", "G2M.Score"))
merged <- RunPCA(merged, npcs = 50, features = VariableFeatures(merged), nfeatures.print = 10)

DimPlot(merged, reduction = "pca")

```

```{r CCA integration}

# Now, split the object based on this characteristc:
merged.list <- SplitObject(merged, split.by="protocol")
bw <- merged.list[["B"]]
mq <- merged.list[["M"]]

integrated.anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = merged.list, dims = 1:20)
to_integrate <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(integrated.anchors@object.list, rownames))
integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = integrated.anchors, dims = 1:20, features.to.integrate = to_integrate)

```

```{r analyse integrated object}

DefaultAssay(integrated) <- "integrated"

# Run the standard workflow for visualization and clustering
integrated <- ScaleData(integrated, verbose = TRUE, vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"))
integrated <- RunPCA(integrated, npcs = 30, verbose = TRUE)

# UMAP and tSNE and Clustering
integrated <- FindNeighbors(integrated, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:20) %>% 
      FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>%
      FindClusters(resolution = 0.2) %>%
      FindClusters(resolution = 0.3) %>%
      FindClusters(resolution = 0.5) %>%
      RunUMAP(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:20)

DefaultAssay(integrated) <- "RNA"

```
